long_description:
Unwind and restore with a peaceful 75-minute yin yoga class in the heart of McGrail Vineyards' cozy candlelit Barrel Room. Surrounded by the warm scent of oak and the gentle glow of candlelight, you’ll be guided through calming, meditative stretches designed to release tension, quiet the mind, and invite stillness.

After class, enhance your evening with an optional wine tasting featuring McGrail’s award-winning wines.

Slow down. Sink in. Sip and savor the moment.

Register here: https://www.joyayoga.com/workshops/candlelight-yin-sound
